english: so it will be able to send us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
text: the clearest pictures…that we have ever seen 把‘最清晰’限定在我们迄今的观看经验中，不是无范围的绝对断言。表达‘我见过最……的’时，可以用最高级加 I've ever seen，把评价和个人经验范围连起来。
